    AI Overview
    Bret Bielema is the head football coach for the University of Illinois (Fighting Illini), a position he has held since December 2020. He has guided the team to three bowl games, including the 2024 Citrus Bowl and 2025 Music City Bowl, and signed an extension in 2025 to lead the program through 2030. 
    Key Details About Illinois Football Coaches (2026): 
    • Head Coach: Bret Bielema
    • Offensive Coordinator/QBs: Barry Lunney Jr.
    • Defensive Coordinator: Bobby Hauck
    • Special Teams Coordinator: Chris Hurd 
    Staff Changes & Other Information: 
    • 2026 Staff Updates: In March 2026, Illinois announced several staff updates, including Chris Hurd as Special Teams Coordinator, Archie McDaniel (Outside Linebackers), and Mike Neu (Pass Game Coordinator).
    • Northern Illinois Coach: Thomas Hammock, the head coach at Northern Illinois University (NIU) since 2019, resigned in February 2026 to join the Seattle Seahawks staff.
    • Basketball Coach: Brad Underwood is the head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team.
